entities.name: Jurgita Štreimikytė-Virbickienė
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jurgita Štreimikytė is a Lithuanian former basketball forward who played the WNBA for Indiana Fever and the Euroleague Women with Kaunas, Valenciennes Olympic and SG Comense among others. She was a member of the Lithuanian national team, winning the 1997 Eurobasket. She retired from international basketball following the 2006 World Championship.
